name: shortcut
description: Shortcut → Windshift one-way sync: catalog + windowed story/comment import, per-project workspaces, delete tombstones, admin control
author: NSXBet

routes.description: Shortcut outgoing webhooks: HMAC-verified story delete/archive → tombstone
Current sync config (secrets masked) + sync state
Run one sync tick inline and return the resulting state
Clear sync state (next tick rebuilds cursors; created items stay)
Delete everything the sync ever created (items, plugin KV, workspaces, team workflows) for a clean re-import
Begin a full-account dump: freezes nothing, state persists in plugin KV, ticks stream entities into file pieces
Run one dump tick within the invocation budget and return the resulting state
Current dump progress: phase, cursor, piece count, counts per entity
Fetch one piece of the assembled NDJSON dump file (?n=0..pieces-1); while a dump runs, n=pieces serves the open in-memory buffer, so partial files download before completion
Delete dump state and every piece from KV (used after a corrupt pause or completed restore)
Current restore progress: phase, chunk cursor, counts per entity, recent errors
Replay one dump-file chunk (?seq=n); re-post the same chunk until the response marks it consumed, then post the next
Delete restore state (used to abandon or restart a restore)
